return.excerpt: When Urashima heard these strange words he was frightened, and said: “Please, please, you must not joke with me, I am greatly perplexed. I am really Urashima Taro, and I certainly have not lived three hundred years. Till four or five days ago I lived on this spot. Tell me what I want to know without more joking, please.” But the man’s face grew more and more grave, and he answered: “You may or may not be Urashima Taro, I don’t know. But the Urashima Taro of whom I have heard is a man who lived three hundred years ago. Perhaps you are his spirit come to revisit your old home?” “Why do you mock me?” said Urashima.
return.note: Ozaki's literary retelling of a traditional story, not a primary mythographic text.

narrativeBlocks.title: The boy who saved a turtle
narrativeBlocks.body: The fisherman Urashima Taro rescues a turtle from boys tormenting it on the beach. Days later the turtle returns and offers to carry him under the sea to the Dragon King's palace.

narrativeBlocks.title: Three years that feel like days
narrativeBlocks.body: In the palace he is feasted by the princess Otohime — dances, wonders, days that slip by like hours. Three years pass without his noticing: enchanted places run on a different clock.

narrativeBlocks.title: The forbidden box
narrativeBlocks.body: When homesickness finally wins, Otohime lets him go with a parting gift: a jeweled box he must NEVER open. Every wonderland has its one rule.

narrativeBlocks.title: Three hundred years late
narrativeBlocks.body: He lands and knows no one. In the village records a stranger reads him an old entry: Urashima Taro went to sea three hundred years ago and never returned. He opens the box — white smoke rises, his stolen centuries, and he becomes an old man on the shore.

narrativeBlocks.title: A folktale, not a myth of gods
narrativeBlocks.body: Unlike this week's Kojiki stories, Urashima is a Japanese folktale — a village story about time, wonder, and the cost of leaving home. Different shelf, same questions.

quiz.prompt: What does Urashima find when he returns home?

choices.text: His village has become a city
Otohime is waiting on the shore
Centuries have passed — his name is in the village records as a man lost at sea three hundred years ago
The turtle has aged into a dragon

quiz.explanation: Time ran differently under the sea — three years down, three hundred up.

quiz.prompt: What happens when he opens the box?

choices.text: White smoke escapes — his true age — and he becomes an old man on the shore

quiz.explanation: The box held his stolen years — opening it lets them catch up.
